redfin.remarks: First time buyer, INVESTOR, 1031 Exchange Opportunity! Top floor two bedroom condo with private balcony and treetop view of the lights of Century City. One of only 8 private residences, this top floor end-unit has 20ft tall ceilings with south facing oversized windows that let in natural light all day long into the living and dining spaces. Truly a great room feel to this residence! Spacious enough to accommodate a large sectional sofa and dining table too! Cozy gas fireplace . Kitchen has stone counters and view of the living areas plus a breakfast bar. Down the hall is a conveniently located laundry closet with stackable WD. The first bedroom on the left has mirrored closet doors and south facing window. The primary suite also has south facing windows and ensuite bathroom with tile shower surround. Additional features include: newer sound proof double pane windows, quality air conditioning system, newer dishwasher and engineered flooring. Location super convenient for UCLA and Westwood Village or the financial district. Short distance to Westwood Park for pickleball, tennis plus a dog park. Westwood is home to a myriad of dining and shopping options plus Sprouts and Bristol Farms. Bike paths, bus and metro lines are conveniently nearby. Only 8 units in this Boutique condo community. Gated subterranean tandem parking for two cars. Elevator and secure lobby! Tenant OCCUPIED - text or call for an appointment - please allow for 24 to 48 hour notice.
